fusions.name: Reef Splinters
fusions.desc: Looses 3 splinters of reef in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Night Spawning
fusions.desc: Sends a cloud of spawn into the first enemy in its path for 28 water damage, splashing 80% of that onto enemies within 3.5 tiles, and leaves the target [Soaked] for 8 seconds. 15% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tidepool Roost
fusions.desc: Raises a reef roost where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Grown From Misses
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
